findings.text: follow-on: the Measure paragraph attributes the head arm to revision d837dec43 ("Head arm (change present), the whole file, head d837dec43: 5 passed") and then calls both arms "the same file at the same revision", but the head arm's own log names a different revision — head-watcher-identity.log's first line reads "# revision: 74e38d7cb35308229f7fe065942afa7d4f6291e6" — so a reader reconciling the landed fragment against the logs it cites finds the arm keyed to the base commit instead of the head; the figures themselves are unaffected and the manifest records the pair correctly.

follow-on: the paragraph asserts "ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the changed file" while the run directory holds no ruff log beside the three pytest logs, and the node's done-when requires every log of this measure to be under the run directory; re-checking the base and head blobs here does confirm the claim (ruff check and ruff format --check both exit 0 on each), so the conclusion is sound but the recorded evidence does not carry it, and a later reader cannot re-run the claim from the run directory.
